content.value_statement: AI features fail when prompts, retrieval, cost, and reliability are treated as demos. This skill gives production patterns for LLM integration, RAG, validation, UX, and monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Explains structured LLM output validation with schemas and function calling.
Covers streaming responses, circuit breakers, fallbacks, and graceful degradation.
Describes RAG retrieval with semantic search, keyword search, reranking, and context limits.
Gives guidance for prompt versioning, testing, and production change control.
Lists checks for API keys, rate limits, token tracking, timeouts, and cost monitoring.
limitations: Provides guidance and examples, not a runnable implementation.
Requires adaptation to the user's model provider, framework, and data constraints.
Does not replace security, legal, or domain expert review for high-stakes AI features.
Example prices and provider names may need current verification before budgeting.

use_cases.title: Plan a Production LLM Feature
use_cases.description: Define validation, latency, cost, and fallback requirements before engineering starts.

use_cases.title: Design a RAG Architecture
use_cases.description: Choose retrieval, reranking, context budgeting, source verification, and update patterns for knowledge features.

use_cases.title: Review AI Launch Readiness
use_cases.description: Check prompts, monitoring, rate limits, error handling, and user trust signals before release.

prompt_templates.title: Review an AI Feature Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-product skill to review this AI feature idea for production risks. Cover validation, latency, cost, and user trust. Feature: [describe feature].

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-product skill to design a RAG workflow for [domain]. Include ingestion, retrieval, reranking, context limits, source display, and failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an LLM Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-product skill to audit this LLM endpoint design: [paste design]. Identify missing validation, rate limits, timeouts, token tracking, streaming, and fallbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Create an AI Readiness Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-product skill to create a release readiness plan for [AI product]. Include prompts as code, evaluation tests, monitoring, cost controls, safety boundaries, incident response, and rollout metrics.

output_examples.input: A team wants to add a support-ticket classifier using LLM output.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use structured output, validate categories and priority, add a fallback queue, and test representative tickets before launch.

output_examples.input: A product needs question answering over internal policy documents.
output_examples.output: Recommended design: use RAG with hybrid retrieval, rerank the top results, enforce context limits, show sources, and verify cited documents.

output_examples.input: A chat feature has rising model costs and slow responses.
output_examples.output: Action plan: stream responses, log token usage by user, cache repeat work, set rate limits, and route simple tasks to cheaper models.

best_practices: Version prompts and test them with representative cases before production changes.
Validate every model response before storing, displaying, or using it in downstream actions.
Track latency, token usage, errors, and cost by feature and user segment.
anti_patterns: Sending raw user input into privileged prompts without boundaries or length limits.
Treating model output as factual or executable without verification.
Shipping a single-provider LLM path without timeout, fallback, or cost limits.

faq.question: Is this a code generator?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture patterns and review checklists for AI product development.

faq.question: Can it help with RAG?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers retrieval, reranking, context limits, source display, and update patterns.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it make AI features secure by itself?
faq.answer: No. It highlights risks and defenses, but teams must still test and review their implementation.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Describe the feature, users, model provider, data sources, latency target, budget, and risk level.

faq.question: Can it estimate costs?
faq.answer: It can identify cost drivers and monitoring needs. Verify current provider pricing before budget decisions.
